obligations.ask: Provide a written response about the pet health plan

results.segment: A written response about the pet health plan is required within 35 days of the date of this letter.
The pet health plan will be reviewed by our assessment team, and a decision is to be issued within 30 days.
This notice is issued for information and no reply is needed to it.
The other party has been given 21 days to respond to this office.
